title: 74% of US Consumers Have Used AI to Shop
paragraphs: Many people are now asking artificial intelligence for help when they go shopping. According to a new report, most American consumers have now used an AI agent while shopping.

The report was published in July 2026 by the technology company CI&T. It found that 74% of US consumers in its survey had already used an AI agent when shopping. An AI agent is a type of AI tool that can carry out tasks for a user, such as searching for products or comparing prices.
The survey also found that 90% of people had either used an AI agent when shopping or were open to using one in the future. Among people who had never used one, 63% said they were open to trying it.

Many shoppers seem happy with the results. In the survey, 78% said that AI makes them smarter shoppers, and 55% said that it actually makes them shop more. The fastest-growing types of products that people shop for with AI are electronics, personal care products, and clothes and accessories.

According to the report, people who use AI agents often begin shopping by asking an agent. However, Melissa Minkow of CI&T said that agents "are not replacing retailers' websites," but they are becoming the first place many people go.

It is important to note that other surveys have found different results. For example, a survey by the consulting company McKinsey in June 2026 found that 48% of US consumers had used AI for shopping. The results depend on how the questions are asked and who answers them.
